content.Clinical Guideline: 2023 Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation

Key Points.Effect on Risk of AF: LA anterior-posterior dimension: ↑ risk (HR per 5 mm ↑, 1.39); End diastolic LA volume (ml): ↑ risk (HR, 1.12); LA emptying fraction: ↑ risk (HR, 1.03)
LV posterior wall thickness: ↑ risk (HR per 4-mm ↑, 1.28)
Higher education: ↑ lifetime risk of AF; Higher education in young individuals: ↓ risk of AF diagnosis
Cumulative socioeconomic disadvantage: ↑ risk (HR, 1.57); Individual's poorest areas: 12% ↑ risk

genes.context: Genetic susceptibility to AF (independent measure) is associated with Indexed LA size and LA ejection fraction (dependent measures); Family history of AF: ↑ risk; Number of AF risk loci is ↑ with 11 number of subjects studied.
GWAS studies confirm a genetic link to atrial fibrillation risk with 11%–42% of the heritability of AF in individuals of European ancestry.
